project: THE NEXT YES — Master Script v6.1.1 Edition
concept: The fear of falling in love again after 50
visual_style: MS-04 Emotional — warm bittersweet cinematic realism
character_continuity: Same 52-year-old American woman in every scene: shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair with subtle silver strands, hazel eyes, natural mature skin texture, camel wool cardigan over dark navy blouse. No de-aging, no glamour retouching, no identity drift.

images.title: TRY AGAIN? — Phone hesitation with eye reflection
images.voice_over: At fifty-two, she wasn't afraid of being alone.
images.reuse: Also used as Scene 10 Loop Trigger

images.title: The fear wasn't loneliness — window with mug
One old hurt. One new possibility. — Empty chair
images.voice_over: She was afraid of choosing wrong again.
images.on_screen_text: One old hurt. One new possibility.

images.title: Phone invitation — thumb hovering
images.voice_over: A painful relationship had taught her caution. Even a kind invitation felt risky. When someone asked her to dinner, she almost said no.
images.on_screen_text: CAUTION + Would you like to get dinner this Friday? + ALMOST: NO

images.title: Wanting connection vs remembering cost — reflection
images.voice_over: Not because she didn't want love. She remembered the cost. Maybe you know that pause: wanting connection, fearing the cost.

images.title: What if protecting my heart means never giving it a chance?
images.voice_over: Then one question stopped her: 'What if protecting my heart means never giving it a chance?'
images.on_screen_text: WHAT IF PROTECTING MY HEART... / ...KEEPS IT CLOSED?

images.title: One coffee — quiet neighborhood café
images.voice_over: She didn't promise a happy ending. Just one coffee—with boundaries, not blind trust.
images.on_screen_text: ONE COFFEE. / NOT A PROMISE. A POSSIBILITY. / Would you give love another chance?

images.title: Know someone starting over? — Reuse café
images.voice_over: Like this. Send it to someone starting over.
images.on_screen_text: KNOW SOMEONE STARTING OVER? / Send it to them.
